name: The Little Nest
tagline: Slow, screen-free days with your little one.
description: Tot school at home, screen-free toddler play, easy toddler meals and gentle motherhood, with the gear and printables that make the days easier.
author: Vallari Gadre

sections.name: Tot School
sections.blurb: Simple preschool-at-home rhythms, themes and 15-minute lessons for ages 1 to 4.

sections.name: Play
sections.blurb: Screen-free activities, busy bags, sensory play and the toys worth buying.

sections.name: Meals
sections.blurb: Easy toddler snacks, lunches and gentle ideas for picky eaters.

sections.name: Motherhood
sections.blurb: Calm routines, gentle discipline and small rituals for slower days.

heroAlt: A sunny playroom with wooden toys and picture books on a low shelf

products.name: The Christmas Toddler Activity Book
products.blurb: 29 print-at-home pages of Christmas tracing, matching and counting, one simple task per page, for five calm minutes at a time.

products.name: 20 Screen-Free Activity Cards
products.blurb: Easy indoor ideas for cold and rainy days, sorted into sensory play, busy hands, movement and quiet time, using things you already have.

products.name: Tot School Weekly Planner
products.blurb: One theme a week, fifteen calm minutes a day: a weekly planner, a filled-in sample week, 24 theme ideas and a supply checklist.

products.name: Busy Book Starter Pages
products.blurb: Color, shape, counting and big-and-small pages with large cut-out pieces, for quiet play in waiting rooms, restaurants and car rides.
